context: living spec: attention-arbitration surfacing consumer leftover
intent: Conversation turns and resume recap mention the highest-priority topically relevant open item via PriorityView, not loops only
approach: TurnSurfacing in ze-priority reads the merged PriorityView snapshot, relevance-filters unsolicited mentions, and is injected into surface_loops / fetch_context so ze-core never imports ze-priority.

decisions.decision: Put TurnSurfacing in ze-priority and inject it as turn_surfacer; keep the surface_loops node name
decisions.why: Ranking and override merge already live in ze-priority; ze-core must not import it; the spec pins surface_loops as the existing path
decisions.rejected: Extend LoopSurfacer or have ze-core call PriorityView.rank() directly

decisions.decision: Merge overrides first, then relevance-filter; do not rank_subset the relevant candidates
decisions.why: Pins are defined on the global snapshot; trimming before merge would drop anchor-relative order

decisions.decision: Explicit whats-open injects AgentContext.open_priorities_note; do not add a companion tool
decisions.why: Companion has no tools and answers with complete(); the resume_recap pattern already injects into every agent system prompt

plan.summary: TurnSurfacing consumes merged PriorityView in conversation and recap
plan.key_finding: rank() does not apply pins; conversation must merge then filter, and ze-core must stay duck-typed
